1. They simply do not have the resources, manpower, or operational capability to deliver the service they promise.

2. Scheduling a service is easy; getting it delivered properly is a different story. Once you book, don't expect reliability or professionalism.

3. The first interaction is designed to create a good impression. After that, you start realizing that most of the promises made during onboarding were nothing more than sales tactics.

4. There is no real "instant support" here. The advertisements, marketing claims, and service commitments are highly misleading and do not reflect the actual customer experience.

5. Most of the 5-star reviews appear to be from first-time customers who have not yet experienced the reality of the service. Try using them repeatedly, and you'll quickly understand why so many customers feel disappointed. What initially looks like a professional service eventually feels like a well-packaged scam.

6. The company seems more focused on acquiring new customers than retaining existing ones. Once you have paid, customer satisfaction no longer appears to be a priority.

7. I would strongly advise potential customers to look beyond the ratings and marketing claims before spending their money here.

I am sharing this not just as my personal experience, but as something I now realize many customers are facing.

Recently, I booked an AC service expecting a professional and reliable experience. The service was completed, but instead of solving problems, it actually created a new one—my AC started leaking water immediately after the service, which was not an issue before.

To resolve this, I had to raise another request. When the technician visited, instead of fixing the problem, I was told that I need to book a completely new service for uninstalling and reinstalling the AC. This felt unreasonable because the issue clearly started after the initial service.

What was even more frustrating was the customer support. I contacted them multiple times, but the response was extremely poor. I was repeatedly told, “Please wait for 2 minutes,” but there was no callback, no follow-up, and no proper solution provided. It felt like once the payment is done, customer concerns are no longer a priority.

After facing this, I checked reviews online—and I was honestly shocked to see how many people are reporting similar issues:

• Services leading to new problems instead of fixing existing ones
• Being asked to book multiple paid requests for the same issue
• Technicians avoiding responsibility and suggesting additional charges
• Customer support delaying responses or not resolving complaints at all
• No accountability or follow-up after service completion

This clearly shows a pattern, not just a one-time issue.

In today’s heat, keeping an AC non-functional is not practical. Customers depend on these services for comfort, and when the service itself becomes the problem, it is unacceptable.

It feels like the focus is only on generating more bookings rather than providing genuine solutions. This approach damages trust and creates a very poor customer experience.

I strongly believe that companies need to take responsibility for post-service issues, improve their support systems, and stop pushing customers into unnecessary additional charges.

I am still waiting for a proper resolution and hope this issue is addressed urgently.

If others have faced similar issues, it’s time these concerns are taken seriously and improvements are made.
